```{r}
fun <- function(x) {
  if (x == "Donor") {"Donor"} 
  else if (x == "NF") {"HLHS"}
  else if (x == "SysHF") {"HLHS"}
}

sample$disease <- mapply(fun, sample$condition)

DimPlot(sample, split.by = "disease", group.by = "global.type")
```

#findmarkers deg
```{r}
sample <- SetIdent(sample, value = sample@meta.data$global.type)
```

#donor vs hlhs
```{r}
output <- "D:/HLHS/2024 final version/7 hlhs sc dex/donor_hlhs/"
sample$celltype.disease <- paste(Idents(sample), sample$disease, sep="_")
sample$celltype <- Idents(sample)
Idents(sample) <- "celltype.disease"
for (i in c('endothelium', 'fibroblast', 'cardiomyocyte', 'myeloid', 'pericyte', 'endocardium', 'tcells', 'smc', 'lymphatic', 'adipocyte', 'neuron', 'bcell', 'mast')){ 
try({
ident1 <- paste0(i,"_Donor")
ident2 <- paste0(i,"_HLHS")
genotype.diffgenes <- FindMarkers(sample, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2=ident2, only.pos = FALSE)
genotype.diffgenes <- genotype.diffgenes[genotype.diffgenes$avg_log2FC > 0.4 | genotype.diffgenes$avg_log2FC < -0.4,]
genotype.diffgenes<- genotype.diffgenes[genotype.diffgenes$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
write.csv(genotype.diffgenes, file=paste0(output,ident1,ident2,".csv"))
})
}
```
